news.headline: uniQure Receives $65.00 Consensus Price Target from Brokerages
news.summary: Seventeen research firms now carry an average 'Moderate Buy' rating on QURE with a consensus one-year price target of $65, with thirteen Buy, three Hold and one Sell rating. The consensus has moved up sharply since the FDA's late-July alignment on an accelerated approval pathway for AMT-130.

news.headline: Barclays Maintains uniQure Overweight Rating, Lowers Price Target to $60
news.summary: Barclays trimmed its price target on QURE to $60 from $65 while keeping an Overweight rating, updating its model after uniQure's Q2 2026 results. The firm's stance remains bullish despite the modest target cut.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Reiterates Buy on uniQure, Price Target Raised to $80
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright kept its Buy rating and lifted its price target to $80 following uniQure's regulatory update, citing the FDA's agreement to drop the sham-surgery control in favor of a standard-of-care confirmatory trial design for AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo upgraded uniQure to Overweight and raised its price target from $60 to $75, pointing to on-track AMT-130 regulatory milestones (Q3 2026 U.S. and U.K. filings, September 4-year data) and a cash position of $810.3 million after the $259 million offering.

news.headline: Wolfe Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Sees 'Clear Path to Approval' for AMT-130
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded QURE from Peer Perform to Outperform with a $65 price target, arguing the market underappreciates the odds of approval and modeling roughly a 70% approval probability with $2 billion in projected peak U.S. sales for AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8 million and cash of $810.3 million (runway into 2030), and confirmed that official FDA Type B meeting minutes align on using 3-year AMT-130 data to support a BLA under the accelerated approval pathway, with filing planned for Q3 2026; shares jumped roughly 5-6% on the news. The company also reported early AMT-260 (epilepsy) and AMT-191 (Fabry) data with updates deferred to H1 2027.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under the accelerated approval pathway, using 3-year Phase I/II data (75% slowing of cUHDRS decline at the high dose) as the primary clinical basis, per FDA Type B meeting alignment confirmed in July 2026.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 4-year Phase I/II data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to present 4-year safety and efficacy data (24 patients, 12 high-dose/12 low-dose) from the ongoing Phase I/II study, which will also support the statistical analysis plan discussed with the FDA.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA Marketing Authorisation Application filing
catalysts.detail: Following a successful pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans to file an MAA for AMT-130 with the UK's MHRA in parallel with the US BLA, based on the same 3-year dataset.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 (epilepsy) second cohort enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second, higher-dose cohort in the Phase I/IIa study of AMT-260 for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 and AMT-191 clinical data
catalysts.detail: Company guidance points to updated Phase I/IIa results for the epilepsy program (AMT-260) and the Fabry disease program (AMT-191) in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Global confirmatory Phase 3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: As part of the accelerated approval pathway, uniQure and the FDA are finalizing a randomized confirmatory study design using standard-of-care as the control arm (instead of sham surgery) with total functional capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint; exact trial start date not yet disclosed.

pulse: uniQure enters the back half of 2026 on the strength of a major regulatory win: official FDA meeting minutes confirmed in late July that 3-year AMT-130 data can support an accelerated-approval BLA using a standard-of-care confirmatory trial instead of a sham-surgery design, sending shares sharply higher and triggering a wave of analyst upgrades (Wolfe to Outperform, Wells Fargo to Overweight) with price targets now clustering in the $60-$80 range and a $65 consensus. Backed by roughly $810 million in cash (runway into 2030) after a $259 million offering, uniQure is on track to file both a US BLA and a UK MAA for AMT-130 in Q3 2026, with 4-year Phase I/II data due in September 2026 as the next major catalyst. Earlier-stage programs in epilepsy (AMT-260) and Fabry disease (AMT-191) remain secondary value drivers, with the next data updates not expected until H1 2027.
